discoveries.name: UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol)
discoveries.why: Standardized shopping lifecycle for agent commerce; typed checkout schemas across REST/MCP/A2A transport; discovery via /.well-known/ucp; relevant for SaaS Factory and Finance Agent commerce flows

discoveries.name: AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol)
discoveries.why: Typed mandates (IntentMandate->PaymentMandate->PaymentReceipt) with cryptographic audit trails; most mature agent payment authorization model; relevant for Finance Agent autonomous spending; v0.1

discoveries.name: A2UI (Agent-to-User Interface Protocol)
discoveries.why: 18 safe component primitives for declarative agent UI composition; flat ID-ref component tree + separate data model; renderable by Lit/Flutter/Angular; A2UI Widget Builder for interactive composition

discoveries.name: AG-UI (Agent-User Interaction Protocol)
discoveries.why: Standardized SSE event stream (TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT, TOOL_CALL_START, etc.) between agent backends and frontends; middleware approach eliminates custom event parsing; CopilotKit maintains it

discoveries.name: Google ADK (Agent Development Kit)
discoveries.why: Google's protocol-native agent framework; first-class support for all 6 protocols (McpToolset, RemoteA2aAgent, to_a2a(), A2UI rendering, AG-UI middleware); Gemini-first but protocol-agnostic patterns
